newsitem.title: HONG KONG: COSCO Pacific down after warrant issues.
newsitem.headline: COSCO Pacific down after warrant issues.

text.p: Shares of COSCO Pacific Ltd fell on profit-taking after running up on Friday ahead of the issue of warrants by three merchants banks, brokers said.
COSCO shares fell HK$0.35, or 5.07 percent, to a session low of HK$6.55 in late morning on volume of 30.14 million shares.
"As buying orders from warrant issuers retreated after the warrants were issued, profit-taking interest dominated," said a sales a manager from a regional brokerage.
Charles de Trenck, senior analyst at Kerry Securities, said the shares were now at an attractive price. "It's a short term adjustment of portfolios becasue it is at an attractive price."
